_comment: COPY THIS TO .qa-areas.local.json IN THE REPO ROOT. That file is git-ignored
and must stay that way: it names the real family's Area id.
protectedAreaIds  the real family. QA refuses every write here.
protectedEventIds the real Christmas, and anything else untouchable.
qaAreaIds         the synthetic Areas QA may write to. Empty until they
exist -- and while it is empty every QA write is refused,
which is the correct state before the rollout.
